name: Black Corporation Deckard's Dream MK2
description: Black Corporation Deckard's Dream MK2 eight-voice analog synthesizer: every controller of its manual's MIDI CC chart, with the ranges it prints.

sources.title: DECKARD'S DREAM MK2 Operation Manual 2.3.0
sources.notes: MIDI CC chart (pages 54, 55, 56 of the PDF) read by tools/profiles/blackcorp/import-black.mjs from deckards_dream_mk2_manual_2.3.0_eng_3b68bdb.pdf (sha256 9c436acf4a7dcdf43ecb2cd311ff446c29e4b059a2cf279a9401f825e15e043d), https://black-corporation.com/m/assets/support/5/deckards_dream_mk2_manual_2.3.0_eng_3b68bdb.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/blackcorp/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/blackcorp/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC chart, sent as a control change. Its name is the chart's less the kind of control (SLIDER, POT, KNOB, BUTTON, SWITCH), which its description keeps. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The chart prints six bands for FEET 1, FEET 2 and the sub-oscillator's FUNCTION, and the manual lists their settings from the top of the slider to the bottom (16' to 2'; sine, saw, reverse saw, square, random, sample & hold, the MK1's external input not on the MK2). The profile takes the first band, 0 - 21, as the top setting, which neither says: check it on the instrument. SUSTAIN SWITCH's two bands are taken as I and II, the switch's own order, likewise.
The two-band switches (SQUARE, SAW) are taken as off and on; the chart prints only the bands.
The manual's MOD WHEEL DESTINATION list gives DETUNE as CC 95; the chart gives SLIDER DETUNE as CC 32 and has no CC 95. The profile follows the chart.

Left out, the wheel, the pedal, bank select and CC 74, the MPE controllers' slide (whose destination the CC74 REPLACE setting chooses): CC 0 BANK SELECT, CC 1 MODULATION WHEEL, CC 64 SUSTAIN PEDAL, CC 74 BRILLIANCE.
